title: Berlin
subtitle: Bespoke Trip Planning
desc: Berlin, built around a birthday and a basketball game. When a group of 17 decided to celebrate a 25th birthday in style, the brief was simple: kick off 2026 with a trip nobody would forget, centred on the NBA Europe game between the Orlando Magic and Memphis Grizzlies. I planned the full week as a flexible itinerary, with a shared nine-bedroom Airbnb as home base, day-by-day plans and a clear price list so everyone knew costs upfront. Three of the group had game tickets, so I made sure the rest never felt like they were waiting around: a team gaming session, jazz bars, riverside food stalls, a smart-casual Italian dinner and plenty of downtime. The result was a trip that worked for basketball fans and non-fans alike.
details:
DATE: January 2026
TRIP TYPE: City Break
GROUP SIZE: 17 People
INCLUDED: Flights, Accommodation, Itinerary, Activities, Transport
review1_text: "Sharleen planned the whole week around the NBA game and somehow made it work for all 17 of us. Everything was clear, from where to stay to what everything would cost. Watching the NBA in Berlin was a dream, and the rest of the week felt just as well thought through."
review2_text: “I didn’t go to the game, but I had an amazing trip anyway. The itinerary kept us busy without feeling rushed. The gaming house and the jazz bar were highlights, and there was still time to relax. The Airbnb was also perfect for all of us"
